intended_object: The Mahler derivation ∂ = (1+X) d/dX on the formal power series ring R⟦X⟧ (i.e. Y d/dY in Y = 1+X), as in Colmez and Rodrigues Jacinto–Williams. Inferred from the docstring and the module documentation.
explanation: The body is the formal derivative `PowerSeries.derivative R`, which is Mathlib's R-derivation d/dX on R⟦X⟧, multiplied by the element 1 + X of R⟦X⟧ using the R⟦X⟧-module structure on derivations. This gives f ↦ (1+X)·f′, and `mahlerDerivation_apply` confirms it by `rfl`. The coefficient formula (n+1)a_{n+1} + n·a_n proved in the file matches the standard formula. Formal power series over any commutative semiring is the natural setting for this derivation, so the definition is not too narrow. Mathlib has no Mahler derivation of its own.
